prompt: By default, how long are PI Message Log files kept, and which tuning parameter controls it?
explanation: Message logs expire after 35 days, controlled by MessageLog_DayLimit. Archive_SecondsBetweenFlush controls the archive write cache and ArcMaxCollect limits query size.

scenario: You need every warning-or-worse message from the last two hours that contains the text [-11091], saved to C:\Temp\arcmax.txt.
explanation: -sw sets the minimum severity to warning, -st/-et give the window (start *-2h, end *), -msg filters text with wildcards and -of writes to a file. Option c has the times reversed and filters by source, and pidiag -e only translates an error code.

prompt: Which PI Server release added migration of the legacy batch database to Event Frames?
explanation: PI Server 2015 added migration of the batch database to Event Frames; RtReports 4.0 added its own batch-to-Event-Frames migration.

prompt: Match each Data Archive message to its meaning.

pairs.right: Event collection exceeded the maximum allowed
Archive query exceeded maximum execution time

explanation: These message examples come from AVEVA's 2023 Data Archive performance session.

prompt: Where do messages go while the PI Message Subsystem is down?

options.text: To the Windows Application Event Log; they are copied into the PI log when it comes back
To the event queue file pimq0000.dat
To pipc.log on the server only

explanation: If the Message Subsystem is down, messages go to the Windows Application Event Log and are copied into the PI log when it returns.

prompt: Match each pigetmsg option to its purpose.
explanation: From the PI Square message-log guide: -f follows, -of sets the output file, -fc gives CSV (with -ft, -fw, -fx for other formats), -top pr summarises by program and -oa outputs all fields.

prompt: Which statements about PI Message Log files on a server are correct? Select all that apply.

options.text: They are in the PI\log folder
They are locked by the Message Subsystem
They are plain text you can edit in Notepad

explanation: Message logs are binary pimsg files in PI\log (PIPC\log on clients), locked by the Message Subsystem; read them with pigetmsg or SMT. The plain-text pipc.log was a legacy PI API log.

prompt: Which pipc.ini setting forwards the legacy pipc.log to the PI Message Log?
explanation: pipc.log was a plain-text log used by older PI API applications; Migratelog=1 in pipc.ini forwards it to the PI Message Log.

prompt: A message shows error -11057 and you want its text. Which command translates the code?
explanation: pidiag -e <code> translates error codes. piartool -ss shows snapshot statistics and pigetmsg -f follows the log.

prompt: Which configuration databases did older PI Servers have? Select all that apply.
explanation: A 2002 OSIsoft session lists PI BatchDB and PI ModuleDB as configuration databases of older PI Servers. The PI Vision database and PIFD belong to later products.

prompt: True or false: a user without read permission on the message log can still diagnose their own write failures from it.
explanation: A PI Square thread notes users without read permission on the message log cannot troubleshoot write failures.
